confidence_notes: July 2026 food estimates draw on sparse Arica price indexes and nearby-month menus. Cocktail and wine estimates use local prices relative to draft beer. Lodging is modeled, with the most uncertainty in dorm beds and basic hotel rooms. [HikersBay](https://hikersbay.com/prices/chile/arica?lang=en) [Expatistan](https://expatistan.com/es/costo-de-vida/arica) [Arica Restobar](https://www.aricarestobar.com/menu?menu=aperitivos)
comparable_city_reasoning: Iquique provides a regional comparison for lodging because both cities are on Chile's northern coast and have seasonal beach tourism. The estimates assume July demand is below the summer peak.
